summary: Seven-volume French novel by Marcel Proust about a narrator's memories, love and place in society. The first volume, Swann's Way, appeared in 1913 and the last in 1927. It is one of the longest novels ever written.
aliases: À la recherche du temps perdu

events.note: The first of its seven volumes was published in 1913 and the last in 1927.
